mentor.hello: Hi! I'm your AI Mentor. I can help with your roadmap, your recommended career, universities or your skills — or just a bit of encouragement. What do you need?
mentor.error: I couldn't process your message. Try again in a moment.
mentor.subtitle: Your vocational guide at FuturePilot

flight.title: Your flight plan
flight.subtitle: You are {{percent}}% of the way through. Here is what comes next.
flight.emptySubtitle: This is where you will see your route and how far your profile can take you. First we need to know what it is.
flight.destinationsNote: Cities and regions known for your career area. Explore them on the globe to see specific universities.
flight.noDestinations: We have not mapped destinations for your area yet. Explore the globe and find them yourself.

allDone.title: Route complete
allDone.body: You have done all six. From here the route is yours to set: every new country and university leaves its stamp.

test.name: Vocational test
test.body: Fifty questions measuring your eight profile dimensions.
test.why: Without this there is nothing to recommend: your profile, your career matches and your destinations all come from here.

profile.name: Your identification
profile.body: Your country and city in the passport.
profile.why: It lets us weigh the options against where you actually are, not in the abstract.

explore.name: Explore countries
explore.body: Three countries on the globe, looking at what is studied where.
explore.why: Your career exists in specific places. Seeing them changes what you think is possible.

universities.name: Discover universities
universities.body: Three universities that fit your career.
universities.why: Going from “I want to study this” to “these places teach it” is the most useful jump there is.

goal.name: Your goal
goal.body: The university you want to reach.
goal.why: Putting a name to the goal changes how everything else reads, and it earns a passport stamp.

mentor.name: Talk to your mentor
mentor.body: A conversation about whatever does not add up.
mentor.why: The mentor knows your real diagnosis. Asking beats guessing.
